reviewNotes: Existing four update languages, separate from AGY seven-language inactive control packets. User-recorded invoice amounts are not bank confirmation, all income, profit or tax compliance. No fluent approval.

releasePairs.english: Review saved invoice amounts by currency
releasePairs.zu: Buyekeza imali yama-invoyisi agciniwe ngohlobo lwemali
releasePairs.st: Hlahloba dipalo tsa di-invoice tse bolokilweng ka mofuta wa tjhelete
releasePairs.ve: Sedzulusanani tshelede ya dzi-invoice dzo vhulungwaho nga lushaka lwa tshelede
releasePairs.ts: Kambisisa mali ya tiinvoyisi leti hlayisiweke hi muxaka wa mali

releasePairs.st: Invoice → Tse bolokilweng → Mofuta wa tjhelete wa kakaretso
releasePairs.ve: Invoice → Dzo vhulungwaho → Lushaka lwa tshelede lwa manweledzo
releasePairs.ts: Invoyisi → Leti hlayisiweke → Muxaka wa mali wa nkatsakanyo

releasePairs.english: Choose one currency to review issued, recorded paid and unpaid invoice amounts on this device. These are invoice records, not verified bank receipts, complete income or profit.
releasePairs.zu: Khetha uhlobo olulodwa lwemali ukuze ubuyekeze imali yama-invoyisi akhishiwe, abhalwe njengakhokhiwe nangakakhokhwa kule divayisi. Lawa amarekhodi ama-invoyisi, hhayi amarisidi asebhange aqinisekisiwe, yonke imali engenayo noma inzuzo.
releasePairs.st: Kgetha mofuta o le mong wa tjhelete ho hlahloba dipalo tsa di-invoice tse ntshitsweng, tse rekotilweng e le tse lefuweng le tse sa lefuwang sesebedisweng sena. Tsena ke direkoto tsa di-invoice, eseng dirisiti tsa banka tse netefaditsweng, lekeno lohle kapa phaello.
releasePairs.ve: Nangani lushaka luthihi lwa tshelede u sedzulusa tshelede ya dzi-invoice dzo bviswaho, dzo rekhodiwaho sa dzo badelwaho na dzi sa athu badelwa kha hetshi tshishumiswa. Hedzi ndi rekhodo dza invoice, a si rasithi dza bannga dzo khwaṱhisedzwaho, mbuelo yoṱhe kana phurofithi.
releasePairs.ts: Hlawula muxaka wun’we wa mali ku kambisisa mali ya tiinvoyisi leti humesiweke, leti rhekhodiweke ti hakeriwile ni leti nga hakeriwangiki eka xitirhisiwa lexi. Leti i tirhekhodo ta tiinvoyisi, a hi tirhisiti ta le bangi leti tiyisisiweke, mali hinkwato leti ngheneke kumbe mpindzulo.
